name: sdb
description: Amazon SimpleDB is a web service providing the core database functions of data indexing and querying in the cloud.

subcommands.name: batch-delete-attributes
subcommands.description: Performs multiple DeleteAttributes operations in a single call, which reduces round trips and latencies.

subcommands.name: batch-put-attributes
subcommands.description: The BatchPutAttributes operation creates or replaces attributes within one or more items.

subcommands.name: create-domain
subcommands.description: The CreateDomain operation creates a new domain.

subcommands.name: delete-attributes
subcommands.description: Deletes one or more attributes associated with an item.

subcommands.name: delete-domain
subcommands.description: The DeleteDomain operation deletes a domain.

subcommands.name: domain-metadata
subcommands.description: Returns information about the domain, including when the domain was created, the number of items and attributes in the domain, and the size of the attribute names and values.

subcommands.name: get-attributes
subcommands.description: Returns all of the attributes associated with the specified item.

subcommands.name: list-domains
subcommands.description: The ListDomains operation lists all domains associated with the Access Key ID.

subcommands.name: put-attributes
subcommands.description: The PutAttributes operation creates or replaces attributes in an item.

subcommands.name: select
subcommands.description: The Select operation returns a set of attributes for ItemNames that match the select expression.
